newsitem.title: USA: Three dead in Houston wall collapse.
newsitem.headline: Three dead in Houston wall collapse.

text.p: Three people died and at least five were injured when a wall collapsed on Thursday at a shopping center where a renovation project was under way, a Houston Fire Department spokesman said.
Some of the victims were thought to be elderly members of a walking group that frequently walked through the mall for exercise, according to news reports.

"There are three confirmed fatalities. It's a good possibility we may find one more," fire department spokesman Rick Flanagan said. He said there were five confirmed injured, but area hospitals were reporting at least six.
The collapse occurred at the site where former basketball player Earvin "Magic" Johnson was building a movie theater.
Flanagan said it was not yet known why the wall collapsed, but a witness, Carol Nunez, told reporters that it may have been tipped over by a tractor.
"They were picking at the building with one of their tractors and then the next thing you know the whole thing just came down," Nunez said.
Rescue teams were going through the rubble with dogs and detection equipment searching for other victims.
